description: Live test of the submitted agent (commit 86506bbc0142865f7e089de0853d9d61ed8f24f0) on 1,000 companies drawn at random from Builderr's official company list, followed by an immediate re-run to check idempotent refresh.

sample.method: mulberry32 pseudo-random generator, seed 20261021, 1,000 distinct rows

how_it_was_run: The agent's own source files (agent/brreg.ts, profile.ts, extract.ts, jobs.ts, types.ts, orgnr.ts) were downloaded from GitHub at the submitted commit, checked by SHA-256 against the commit, bundled with esbuild-wasm and run in a browser tab on data.brreg.no (node:crypto/fs/path replaced by browser equivalents). Hiring was run separately from a tab on pam-stilling-feed.nav.no, because NAV's feed only answers its own origin; in that tab annual accounts cannot be read, so the hiring run is used for hiring figures only. Equivalent command: npx tsx agent/run.ts examples/smoke-1000.txt out

agreement_with_builderr_universe_file.note: The universe file is a snapshot from earlier in 2026; the agent reads the live registers, so some differences are real changes since the snapshot.

legal_name.example: 922781745: ARILD NORDHEIM MASKINENTREPRENØR AS is now ARILD NORDHEIM ENTREPRENØR AS

latest_filed_accounts_year.example: 975854795 has since been deleted from the register

hiring_recall_check.method: Separately, every active NAV ad in the same 60-day window (9,030) was opened and its employer organisation number compared with the 1,000 companies and their 894 registered sub-units.
missed: 925036226 (HUMAN CARE UNG AS): 4 ads posted by two of its sub-units under the brand name 'Humana omsorg og assistanse'
931723499 (SOLBYEN MAKI HOUSE AS): 1 ad posted by its sub-unit under the brand name 'SushiTake Meny Sarpsborg'
hiring_recall_check.cause: The agent finds candidate ads by employer name and then confirms the organisation number. Ads posted under a brand name never become candidates, and those companies are reported as having no active ads.
hiring_recall_check.fix_direction: Index every active ad by its employer organisation number once per run (about 9,000 detail requests), so matching never depends on the name.
